patterns_found.name: Change of Character (CHoCH)
patterns_found.evidence: Market structure shifted from bearish lower highs/lows (1900 to 1725) to bullish structure. Price broke above prior swing highs around 1800-1825 and is holding above 1800 with higher lows near 1775.

patterns_found.name: Inverse Head and Shoulders
patterns_found.evidence: Three swing lows visible: left shoulder ~1775, head ~1725, right shoulder ~1775. Neckline resistance around 1800-1825 has been breached with price trading near 1835.
